pull_request_body: Replace the hand-written legacy IPv4 parser in core/validation.py with socket.getaddrinfo and the AI_NUMERICHOST flag. The C library parses all legacy forms (octal, hex, one-to-three-part, integer) without a DNS query. Delete _parse_part, _combine_ipv4_parts, _parse_legacy_ipv4, the repeated metadata check in _enforce_non_private_ssrf, and two unreachable branches. Add tests for octal, three-part, zone-ID, and unparsable-is-private forms. Existing tests for one-part, two-part, and hex forms still pass. No test starts a program or makes a DNS query.
why: #2152: The SSRF and egress checks in core/validation.py parse legacy numeric IP hosts with a hand-written parser. AGENTS.md and #1107 make a hand-rolled address parser a defect. Some parser forms and classifier branches have no test, and two branches cannot run.
what_changes: Add tests for octal, three-part, zone-ID, and unparsable-is-private forms of legacy numeric IPs
Replace parse_numeric_ip to use socket.getaddrinfo with AI_NUMERICHOST and ipaddress
Delete the repeated metadata check in _enforce_non_private_ssrf
Delete the unreachable return None and unreachable except clause
Add spec requirements for numeric-host-parsing, unparsable-host-is-private, and ipv6-zone-id-stripped to public-api-egress
feasibility: The issue confirms socket.getaddrinfo with AI_NUMERICHOST returns 127.0.0.1 for 0177.0.0.1, 127.1, 127.0.1, 2130706433, 0x7f.1, and 0x7f000001 on Python 3.14.7/glibc, and refuses 08.0.0.1 and 1.2.3.4 x (checked 2026-10-24).
The hermetic floor in tests/conftest.py:311-323 lets getaddrinfo through when the AI_NUMERICHOST flag is set, so tests can call it without a DNS query.
pyproject.toml:141-145 bans socket.inet_aton under TID251 (#1107), confirming getaddrinfo is the sanctioned path.

First checks the implementation runs: uv run pytest tests/test_reference_extractor.py tests/test_builtin_tools.py -k 'numeric or ip' to confirm existing tests pass before and after the change; uv run devops ci to confirm the full gate including the constructs row passes.
existing_tool: socket.getaddrinfo with the AI_NUMERICHOST flag is the stdlib tool that parses a numeric host with the C library's own rules and makes no DNS query. No external library is needed. The change deletes the internal code _parse_part, _combine_ipv4_parts, and _parse_legacy_ipv4 in src/devops_cli/core/validation.py.

decisions.decision: Use socket.getaddrinfo with AI_NUMERICHOST to parse legacy numeric IP hosts
decisions.reason: The C library's own rules handle all legacy forms correctly. The hermetic floor in tests/conftest.py:311-323 allows the call through. AGENTS.md and #1107 make a hand-rolled parser a defect.

decisions.decision: Delete the repeated metadata check in _enforce_non_private_ssrf
decisions.reason: validate_url, its only caller, already performs the same check before calling _enforce_non_private_ssrf. The raise at line 614 cannot run and is dead code.

decisions.decision: Delete the unreachable branches at lines 229 and 255-256
decisions.reason: Line 229 is excluded by the caller's 1-to-4 check. Lines 255-256 catch exceptions that _parse_legacy_ipv4 never raises. Both are dead code.

rejected.alternative: Use socket.inet_aton to parse legacy numeric IPs
rejected.evidence: pyproject.toml:141-145 bans socket.inet_aton under TID251, citing #1107. The rule is active in the project.

rejected.alternative: Keep the hand-written parser and add the missing tests
rejected.evidence: AGENTS.md rule 3 and #1107 make a hand-rolled address parser a defect. The project policy is to use the resolver's own parser, not a custom one.

added.name: numeric-host-parsing
added.text: The egress checks SHALL parse a numeric IP host using socket.getaddrinfo with the AI_NUMERICHOST flag and classify the result with ipaddress.

scenarios.name: octal form is refused
scenarios.when: validate_url is called with http://0177.0.0.1/ and allow_private is False
scenarios.then: the call raises an error refusing the private address

scenarios.name: three-part form is refused
scenarios.when: validate_url is called with http://127.0.1/ and allow_private is False
scenarios.then: the call raises an error refusing the private address

scenarios.name: hex form is refused
scenarios.when: validate_url is called with http://0x7f.1/ and allow_private is False
scenarios.then: the call raises an error refusing the private address

scenarios.name: integer form is refused
scenarios.when: validate_url is called with http://2130706433/ and allow_private is False
scenarios.then: the call raises an error refusing the private address

added.name: unparsable-host-is-private
added.text: The egress checks SHALL treat a host value that does not parse as an IP address as private.

scenarios.name: unparsable value is treated as private
scenarios.when: is_private_ip is called with a value that does not parse as an IP address

added.name: ipv6-zone-id-stripped
added.text: The egress checks SHALL strip an IPv6 zone ID before classifying the address.

scenarios.name: link-local address with zone ID is refused
scenarios.then: the call returns True, treating the address as link-local

groups.title: Add tests for legacy numeric IP forms and classifier edge cases
groups.test: Write tests: validate_url with allow_private=False refuses http://0177.0.0.1/ and http://127.0.1/; is_loopback_or_private_host treats fe80::1%eth0 as link-local; is_private_ip returns True for a value that does not parse as an IP address
groups.implementation: Add test functions to tests/test_reference_extractor.py. Each test calls the public API with the specified input and asserts the expected refusal or classification. The tests pin the behavior before the implementation changes
groups.verify: uv run pytest tests/test_reference_extractor.py -k 'octal or three_part or zone_id or unparsable'

groups.title: Replace hand-written IPv4 parser with getaddrinfo and delete dead code
groups.test: The tests added in the previous group and the existing tests in tests/test_reference_extractor.py and tests/test_builtin_tools.py must all pass after the change
groups.implementation: Rewrite parse_numeric_ip: first try ipaddress.ip_address(host); on ValueError, call socket.getaddrinfo(host, None, flags=socket.AI_NUMERICHOST) and pass results[0][4][0] to ipaddress.ip_address; catch OSError and return None. Delete _parse_part, _combine_ipv4_parts, and _parse_legacy_ipv4. Delete the repeated cloud-metadata check in _enforce_non_private_ssrf since validate_url already performs it
